senses.gloss: m., pl. עַרְסִיִּין (preced. art.) belonging to a bedstead; (מלין) ע׳ strapping, girthing.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 7:2:45">Y. Sabb. VII, 10ᶜ</cite> top <he>הן דעבד מ׳ ע׳ וכ׳</he> (Or Zar.
<cite ref="Shabbat 64a">Sabb. 64</cite> <he>דעביד ערסמו</he>, read <he>ערסיין</he>) he who does girthing work (on the Sabbath), if lengthwise &c.
